source: applied rewrites from the independent-critic rounds on data/aggregates/hero-coach-critique.json (rounds 1-2), kept so a re-ingest of the same authored line reproduces the JUDGED text instead of reverting to the pre-judge draft; each fix is re-verified by copy-verify against the current facts before it is applied

adele:support.Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash: After a teammate commits, Imperial Lash to root and dash onto their carry, then drop Queen’s Garden under them so allies cash in the Thorns bonus. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith finish by minute 21, keep Iron Rose up and stand in front.

akeron:jungle.Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win the str: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win the straight fight, so clear your own camps and gank sidelanes instead of invading into them — Rampage and Boris are fights you can take.

argus:support.Peel with Ether Crystal: it shoves diver: Use Ether Crystal to protect your carry: it shoves attackers off them, then pulls them back in as it implodes, and follow with Dread Nova to stun. Stonewall and Warden's Faith by minute 21 let you block for them instead of backing away.

aurora:offlane.Greystone, Steel and Zarus beat you earl: Greystone, Steel and Zarus beat you early, so hold Glacial Charge as an escape and farm until your team can join you.

aurora:support.Engaging before your carry is in range l: Engaging before your carry is in range leaves you alone behind their team, so wait until they can follow you in before you use Glacial Charge.

countess:midlane.Gideon and The Fey out-range you, so nev: Gideon and The Fey out-range you, so never Shadow Slip in without saving the swap to get you back out.

countess:jungle.Kwang wins the straight fight, so clear: Kwang wins the straight fight, so stay off his side of the jungle — invade into Serath, Rampage, Boris or Feng Mao instead, and keep the Shadow to slip out.
countess:jungle.Dive a grouped team and Shadow Slip won': Dive a grouped team and Shadow Slip won't save you — swap back to the Shadow early, or wait until you catch someone alone.

gideon:midlane.Black Hole can't be cancelled once cast: Once Black Hole has finished channelling it can't be cancelled — don't open with it alone; wait for a teammate's stun or the enemy to commit first.

greystone:offlane.Steel and Zarus win this lane \u2014 Sto: Steel and Zarus win this lane — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.

greystone:jungle.Gank with Assault The Gates \u2014 hitti: Gank with Assault The Gates — hitting a hero cuts its cooldown — then Make Way to shred armor and Sacred Oath to cleave. Stone Forged Soul heals you back up when a dive goes wrong; Krix adds tankiness, not damage.

iggy-scorch:offlane.Lay Flame Turrets in the bushes, then Oi: Lay Flame Turrets in the bushes, then Oil Spill across the lane and ignite it with Molotov to hold them off the wave. Basic attacks stack Slick for extra burn; Wraith Leggings by minute 25 lets you walk away from whoever jumps you.
iggy-scorch:offlane.Melee bruisers kill turrets fast \u2014: Melee bruisers kill turrets fast — when one jumps you, save Inferno's knockback to shove them off you rather than burning it for damage.

kwang:offlane.Poke with Judgement of the Heavens, then: Poke with Judgement of the Heavens, then Surge of the Heavens into the blade to snap it back and knock them up. Landing an ability Energizes your blade, and the lightning basic attack that follows cuts your cooldowns; by minute 24 you can stand in the fight and keep swinging.

lt-belica:midlane.Against Gideon, The Fey, Countess or Igg: Gideon, The Fey, Countess and Iggy & Scorch all come out ahead in this lane, so hold Seismic Assault for their engage and farm safely.

lt-belica:support.Against Dekker you lose the checkpoint t: Dekker comes out ahead in this lane, so stop walking up for Seismic Assault and use Void Drone for vision while your carry farms.

murdock:carry.Drop Static Trap on the path they must w: Drop Static Trap on the path they must walk, then use Buckshot as they step in for the armor shred — it pushes them back, so keep your distance and keep basic attacking with Hot Pursuit up. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done by minute 19 those attack chains kill on their own.

murdock:offlane.Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all w: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all come out ahead in this lane, so give up the wave, farm under tower and ask your jungler for help.

shinbi:offlane.Poke with Line Tempo, then dash in with: Poke with Line Tempo, then dash in with Rushing Beat and turn on Circle Rhythm for the shield while your wolves chew on them. Every ability that damages a hero builds Track — at 8 stacks cash it in with All-Kill! — and Spectral Schematics and Timewarp by minute 19 make that rotation hit harder.

sparrow:carry.Most enemy carries beat you early \u2014: Most enemy carries come out ahead in this lane — if Murdock, Drongo or Eden are pushing the wave into you, farm safely with Piercing Shot instead of trading basic attacks.

terra:offlane.Wild Rush's long channel gets punished b: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all come out ahead in this lane, and Wild Rush needs up to a 3.5s wind-up, so don't open fights with it — use it to escape or follow up.

yin:jungle.Open with Q Lash Kick to yank yourself o: Open with Q Lash Kick to yank yourself onto them and slow them hard, turn on E Windburn for the extra range and cleave, then keep attacking — Windburn's passive makes every third attack in a row deal bonus damage and heal you. Solaris, Viper and Spear Of Desolation by minute 25 make that chain finish kills.
yin:jungle.You lose most even jungle duels \u2014 u: You lose most jungle duels head-on — use RMB Backlash to turn away their shots and only fight when a teammate is already there.

gadget:midlane.Root them with Security Gate, stick Stic: Root them with Security Gate, stick Sticky Mine on and land a Spark basic attack so the mine goes off empowered for the bigger hit, then Seek and Destroy as they run. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings land you can commit Tesla Dome on top.

mourn:support.Open with Abduct to drag someone out of: Open with Abduct to drag someone out of position, follow with Beguile to hold them, then Contagion to heal your carry and strip their armor. Between fights chip at them from range instead of committing; Oblivion Crown lands at minute 29.

rampage:jungle.Khaimera, Kwang and Kallari take the che: Khaimera, Kwang and Kallari all beat you in a straight fight — don't duel them without Behemoth up; farm and gank the lanes instead.

scarlett:offlane.Zarus wins the checkpoints \u2014 don't: Zarus comes out ahead in a straight fight — don't burn First Intent to engage him; keep it as the escape and shield refresh.

scarlett:jungle.Kwang wins the checkpoints \u2014 don't: Kwang comes out ahead in a straight fight — don't invade him early; take your own camps and gank a lane where Swan Song can catch someone.

sevarog:offlane.Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus win t: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all beat you in a straight fight — farm Souls safely and fight only with Subjugate up.

sevarog:jungle.Don't invade Khaimera or Kwang early \u2: Don't invade Khaimera or Kwang early — they beat you in a straight fight; take your own camps and gank the lanes instead.

steel:support.Dekker wins the lane checkpoints \u2014: Dekker beats you in a straight fight — don't engage first; hold Shield Slam until after she commits and use it to protect your carry.

zinx:offlane.Open with Ricochet to stun, drop Bad Med: Open with Ricochet to stun, drop Bad Medicine under them for the slow and second burst, then keep basic attacking — Refibrillator's burn stacks on every hit and keeps ticking. Oathkeeper lands at minute 19.
zinx:offlane.Every offlane checkpoint here goes to th: Every offlane matchup here goes against you — farm safe, use Infuse and Neural Regenesis to keep allies alive, and don't duel.

zinx:midlane.Every midlane checkpoint goes to the ene: Every midlane matchup here goes against you — don't trade on your own; play behind your jungler and win fights with Infuse and the revive.

revenant:carry.Reckoning locks you alone with the targe: Reckoning locks you alone with the target, so pulling Sparrow, Skylar or Drongo, who beat you head-on, hands them the kill.

riktor:jungle.Khaimera and Kwang beat you at the check: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in a straight fight, so don't duel them for camps; take the far side and gank a lane instead.

serath:jungle.Khaimera, Kwang, Feng Mao and Kallari al: Khaimera, Kwang, Feng Mao and Kallari all beat you in a straight fight, so don't invade early; farm your own camps until Heresy is up.

note: the "checkpoints" swaps on revenant/riktor/serath apply the same ruling the critic made on eight other lanes (engine-internal vocabulary the UI never shows the reader); heroes named and actions advised are unchanged
